definition: the speaker will probably lose what the slot names
expansion: (situation CREDENCE PROBABLE (HOLDER (term SELF)) (CONTENT (situation lose (HOLDER (term SELF)) (UNDERGOER (slot 1)) (EVENT-TIME AFTER NOW))))
